arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Hard start then settle to about critical power (pod ~151 W, boat ~89 W) through legs 1-5, aiming to finish with the pod reserve near empty. Hold even effort; compare same-direction legs to read current. Start final push around 800-1000 m to go if reserve allows (pod reserve above ~40%). Watch for anything slowing the boat at steady power (rudder weed, drag) via push_local and speed at same power. CP may be 10-25% off: check whether reserve trend matches how the paddler feels.

arguments.message: Boat slower than pod power plus current predicts: possible weed, drag or pod problem

arguments.text: Good start. Settle into race rhythm now.

arguments.reason: check the paddler has settled near critical power after the start

text: Set plan and watches for drag and pod reserve; cued settle to about 163 s/500 after hard start; wake in 75 s to check.

arguments.text: Ease a little more. Long smooth strokes, save it for later.

2.4 min: first ease cue (163 s/500) at 1.2 min not followed (pod 180 W before and after). Pod 168 W vs CP 151, pod reserve 57%, boat reserve 44% (boat number falls faster: boat/shaft ratio 0.68 now vs 0.59 in test, and push_local 0.28 vs push_along 0.16 on leg 1 north, so boat reserve likely over-reads the spend). Trust pod. Re-cued ease to 159 s/500 over ground at 2.4 min.

arguments.reason: check second ease cue took effect

text: Cued ease to 159 s/500: pod power still above critical power and reserve falling; wake in 70 s.

arguments.message: Pod power above the pace that lasts to the finish
Pod power well below what the reserve allows: room to push

arguments.text: 3.7 min: second ease cue worked (pod 179 to 161 W). Now pod 158 W vs sustainable 155, pod reserve 51%. Boat reserve 27% and boat power 105 vs CP 89: boat/shaft ratio 0.67 vs 0.59 in test. After turn 1, compare leg 2 ratio: if still about 0.67, boat CP is probably low (about 100 W) and could be corrected with set_critical_power. Watches over_sustainable and under_sustainable set on pod power.

text: no cue: pod power now close to sustainable after the second ease cue; added pacing watches.
